description: Thin integer humanoid transduction bridge for the general developmental graph, including goal-relative local inverse kinematics by analysis-by-synthesis over learned consequences.

rules.name: hdc_open_goal_relative_inverse_kinematic_bootstrap
rules.comment: Turn the active generic developmental goal into an integer task-space residual. This is an output-null query over learned forward consequences, never an authored pose or solver.

rules.name: hdc_score_local_forward_models_against_inverse_residual
rules.comment: Materialize one residual-after-action cost per opaque local forward model. Later parallel program searches read this integer result instead of re-expanding the inverse expression.

rules.name: hdc_apply_general_developmental_capability_goal
rules.comment: The general capability frontier supplies only a goal. The humanoid motor graph still synthesizes and verifies the action.

rules.name: hdc_synchronize_generic_developmental_motor_task_context
rules.comment: Translate the active capability's generic task-space contract into temporary motor-context authority. Self-takeoff is open while an upright supported synthesis can begin; a transient competing recovery-mode bit does not erase the task intention. It closes on a material viability verdict, flight, loss of support, or when the capability changes.

rules.name: hdc_retire_orientation_authority_outside_orientation_manifold
rules.comment: A developmental orientation bundle remains retained as experimental evidence, but its ready edge is actuator authority. Once the active capability no longer asks for orientation evidence, that authority lies outside the current future manifold and must close before another controller can establish its path.

rules.name: hdc_release_stale_postural_recovery_program_for_intentional_locomotion
rules.comment: Intentional locomotor development may inherit an output-potent postural program from the preceding developmental stage. Release only that transient authority after the locomotor drive is active and recovery is inactive. A shared sensorimotor interrupt or reset request keeps material viability authority intact; the learned program remains retained graph data.

rules.name: hdc_release_stale_postural_recovery_basin_for_intentional_locomotion
rules.comment: After transient postural program authority is gone, release the current-basin pointer so phenotype discovery can treat the present configuration as a candidate locomotor basin. Stored basins and their learned actions are retained, and material interrupts prevent this rule from firing.

rules.name: hdc_restore_reactivated_program_trajectory_to_hot_frontier
rules.comment: A suspended stable trajectory re-enters generic selection only when its capability is genuinely available or active again.

rules.name: hdc_request_generic_order_n_program_trajectory
rules.comment: The developmental capability supplies a situated owner and the body's evidence window supplies its horizon. The generic trajectory faculty owns expansion and selection. An explicit target shape is optional once receipt-grounded manifold bounds define the acceptable path family.

rules.name: hdc_open_unseen_physics_counterfactual_compound
rules.comment: A physics residual recruits receipt-learned opaque commands from at least two independent effector groups. The result is an output-null counterfactual, not an action or a replay.

rules.name: hdc_bind_receipt_learned_component_per_effector_group
rules.comment: One locally learned command represents each independent group. Group count and compound width fall out of the sensed body.

rules.name: hdc_forward_project_unseen_compound_consequences
rules.comment: Forward-project the unseen simultaneous program using only integer consequences learned from its components. Nonlinear interaction remains explicit uncertainty until the physical receipt.

rules.name: hdc_release_selected_counterfactual_through_motor_collapse
rules.comment: Physics proposal selection grants no actuator output. This adapter exposes the chosen compound to the ordinary single motor collapse, which still owns material-envelope interruption.

rules.name: hdc_exhaust_ineffective_orientation_bundle
rules.comment: A replay-budgeted bundle whose latest physical receipt has no orientation escape is retained as experimentally relevant negative evidence, but no longer blocks a new analysis-by-synthesis candidate for the same support phase.

rules.name: hdc_open_arbitrary_width_orientation_escape_bundle
rules.comment: Compose one command per independently discovered effector group when its own receipts predict escape from the current supported surface. The bundle width is discovered from the body, never fixed.

rules.name: hdc_hold_best_orientation_program_open_until_boundary
rules.comment: Practice is a meta-program: repeatedly reissue the best receipt-grounded compound orientation program while the developmental boundary remains open. A quarter- or half-turn receipt closes it.

rules.name: hdc_handoff_passive_body_mapping_to_self_authored_attempt
rules.comment: Passive cycling supplies a situated body map but no agency credit. The next graph collapse is a fresh self-authored test.

rules.name: hdc_open_self_authored_attempt_without_caregiver_permission
rules.comment: Caregiver evidence can warm-start the body map but is never permission to develop. When it is absent or noncontingent, select the least-experienced situated command and learn its consequence.

rules.name: hdc_audit_learned_caregiver_support_counterfactual
rules.comment: Compose the child's issued motor program with the learned exafferent support consequence through native analysis by synthesis. These fields are audit evidence only; this rule neither requests nor enacts caregiver support.

rules.name: hdc_request_counterfactual_caregiver_protection
rules.comment: When explicitly enabled for an experiment, add caregiver support only where the enacted unsupported path escapes and the learned exafferent composition preserves it. Existing support rules remain authoritative and are never suppressed by this rule.

rules.name: hdc_request_caregiver_protection_for_unfamiliar_calibration
rules.comment: Before the developmental capability frontier opens, caregiver protection follows unfamiliarity of the actual selected command relative to the body-derived somatomotor field size.

rules.name: hdc_request_caregiver_protection_for_under_evidenced_attempt
rules.comment: A caregiver changes the situated consequence envelope. Protection is requested while the active capability has less successful situated evidence than its body-derived window, then fades without an age or milestone constant. Failed attempts are evidence about the basin, but they are not evidence that support can already be withdrawn.

rules.name: hdc_issue_current_sensed_developmental_efference_copy
rules.comment: Agency prediction does not require a privileged fixation. Copy the self-authored command relative to the current sensed body configuration and let the later receipt confirm it.

rules.name: hdc_bind_current_sensed_reference_without_privileged_fixation
rules.comment: A moving or unfamiliar body need not invent a fixed reference posture. The current sensed shape supplies coordinates with or without caregiver evidence.

rules.name: hdc_close_causally_verified_developmental_self_attempt
rules.comment: The active attempt earns agency only through its own receipt; the earlier passive trajectory remains exafferent.

rules.name: hdc_reverify_passive_body_model_with_confirmed_active_agency
rules.comment: A passive envelope predicts what can happen to the body. Only a fresh verified receipt with a confirmed efference copy earns evidence that this graph collapse caused the consequence.

rules.name: hdc_index_wave_cell_local_commands
rules.comment: Cache the immutable topology join between a generic wave cell and body-local opaque commands. Receipt-derived rank, support phase, and actuator-group exclusion stay live at selection.

rules.name: hdc_open_humanoid_program_from_somatomotor_wave
rules.comment: The generic wave supplies a parallel effector field. This bridge adds no anatomy or desired pose; it only opens the normal humanoid compound-program receipt path.

rules.name: hdc_bind_wave_cells_to_least_experienced_local_commands
rules.comment: Each active topology cell chooses a currently situated opaque command using only integer consequences learned from receipts. This turns babbling into goal-relative practice while preserving one coherent compound collapse.

rules.name: hdc_mint_situated_orientation_action_evidence
rules.comment: Index vestibular consequences by the supported surface from which the opaque action was enacted. Opposite body surfaces are distinct future manifolds even when support phase is unchanged.

rules.name: hdc_learn_integer_developmental_action_affordance
rules.comment: Retain receipt-derived integer consequences on the opaque action model so later waves can recruit commands by developmental affordance without a pose target, scalar reward, or float policy.

rules.name: hdc_learn_integer_compound_program_developmental_affordance
rules.comment: A compound program is judged by its actual whole-body receipt, preserving nonlinear analysis-by-synthesis consequences that cannot be inferred by adding its individual command models.

rules.name: hdc_publish_verified_motor_transition_to_generic_trajectory
rules.comment: Bridge one receipt-grounded predecessor/successor edge into body-neutral integer state coordinates. No prediction or host decision is introduced by this publication step.

rules.name: hdc_mint_receipt_grounded_developmental_program_transition
rules.comment: Developmental programs do not require the legacy gait task-context learner. Consecutive verified receipts directly mint one body-neutral integer edge before current context advances.

rules.name: hdc_clear_stale_trajectory_state_source
rules.comment: A program node is an action, not the body's state. Withdraw transition sources whose learned pre-state no longer matches the latest categorical physical receipt or whose next program no longer preserves the current future manifold.

rules.name: hdc_bind_trajectory_state_source_from_latest_receipt
rules.comment: Re-anchor every learned transition matching the latest categorical receipt, but publish only next programs admitted by the native analysis-by-synthesis future projection. Batch publication lets the generic selector compare all viable current continuations.

rules.name: hdc_clear_selected_trajectory_without_current_state_source
rules.comment: A selected path is live only while at least one of its transitions is admissible from the latest receipt-grounded state. The path remains retained evidence after its selection edge clears.

rules.name: hdc_audit_selected_trajectory_manifold_gate
rules.comment: Publish the exact graph-native projection verdict that permits or blocks a selected path's next program. Audit has no actuator or completion authority.

rules.name: hdc_reject_selected_trajectory_in_current_manifold_context
rules.comment: A failed projection refutes this path only from the current receipt-grounded transition source. The generic selector may choose another frontier path; no actuator authority is created.

rules.name: hdc_archive_selected_trajectory_after_capability_mastery
rules.comment: Mastery closes the capability's practice question. Retain its path and audit facts, but remove the live selection edge so it cannot compete with the next developmental capability.

rules.name: hdc_park_inactive_program_trajectory_off_hot_frontier
rules.comment: Mastered and meta-suspended capabilities retain one stable trajectory identity and every evidence node, while disabling its generic expansion and selection work.
